prepared.title: Planning the Spring Glaze Workshop
prepared.text:
Before week 1:

- [ ] Two 25 lb bags of mid-fire stoneware
- [ ] Eight sets of basic tools: needle tool, wooden rib, sponge, wire cutter
- [ ] Ware boards or shelves for 16 drying pieces, with name labels
- [ ] Three to five glazes that you have already test-fired on this clay
- [ ] About 20 bisqued test tiles, so students can try glazes in week 3
- [ ] Aprons, or a note asking people to wear old clothes

Also check the kiln shelves and kiln wash before week 2, so the bisque firing is not delayed.
